topics.label: Introduction and overview of cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: These remarks introduce the lecture, establish the learning outcomes, and present the overarching framework of the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Sustained proliferative and survival signaling
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how oncogenic mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream cascades drive constitutive growth signaling and cell survival.

topics.label: Blocked differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how malignancies in both hematopoietic and epithelial tissues arrest terminal differentiation while maintaining a proliferative state.

topics.label: Resistance to apoptosis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how tumor cells evade programmed cell death through mutations in p53 and dysregulation of Bcl-2 family proteins.

topics.label: Telomere biology, senescence, and genome protection checkpoints
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the limits of cellular replication, mechanisms of telomerase reactivation, stress-induced senescence checkpoints, and the consolidation of cell-autonomous growth hallmarks.

topics.label: Cancer metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss the metabolic reprogramming of cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific metabolic rewiring, and oncogenic enzyme mutations.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines how developing tumors induce new blood vessel formation to overcome diffusion limits and sustain tissue oxygenation.

topics.label: Invasion, metastasis, and secondary dissemination
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the multistep cascade of metastatic spread, clinical monitoring of circulating tumor cells, microenvironmental compatibility, and metastatic genomics.

topics.label: Conclusion and closing remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These closing remarks summarize the key takeaways of the lecture and provide final housekeeping details for upcoming sessions.
